evidence.mirrorMoon:
Our mansion's gardens are vast fields of green.
Surrounded by a thick, dense forest.
With the trees blanketing out the light,
almost like a massive curtain.
evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: Our mansion's gardens are vast fields of green.

mm-0001.reason: The Japanese describes the surrounding trees as black upon black and like a huge curtain. mirror moon invents vast green fields and replaces the trees' explicit blackness with their blocking out the light, altering the dream's dark theatrical image while retaining the forest and curtain comparison.
mm-0001.title: Black trees become green fields and light-blocking trees

evidence.japanese:
すごく、くらい。

evidence.mirrorMoon:
Darkness surrounds me…
A blackness so deep, it's suffocating…
Not even the calming rays of the moonlight can reach this deep.
evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: Not even the calming rays of the moonlight can reach this deep.

mm-0002.reason: The conspicuously marked ツメタイヒカリ is cold light, continuing the dream's coldness. Calling the light calming introduces the opposite affect and makes an inferred moonlight soothing rather than cold.
mm-0002.title: Cold light is made calming

evidence.japanese:

evidence.mirrorMoon:

evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: But it is just so cruel…

mm-0003.reason: The child is simply cold and feels on the verge of tears for no reason. mirror moon replaces 寒い with a moral judgment, 'cruel,' breaking the cold motif and supplying an interpretation the dissociated narration avoids.
mm-0003.title: Cold becomes cruelty

evidence.japanese:

evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: Because that is where the first dog's "point" was.

In this room.

evidence.label: s94

----But, that's just sugar-coating it.

mm-0746.reason: The nightmare withholds the acting subject through subjectless Japanese and repeatedly frames Shiki as an uncertain observer; even the heat is said to affect 'the one watching.' The late detail of long hair helps destabilize whose experience this is. mirror moon inserts first-person subjects into the outing, hunt, mutilation, observer, and hair in all three recurrences, prematurely declaring every act and body Shiki's and damaging a central Akiha-route identity effect.
mm-0746.title: The nightmare withholds the acting subject through subjectless Japanese and repeatedly frames Shiki as an uncertain observer; even the heat is said to affect 'the one watching.' The late detail of long hair helps destabilize whose experience this is

mm-0879.title: SHIKI names his governing emotion precisely as humiliation: killed by his best friend, stripped of name, status, and Akiha

evidence.japanese:

evidence.label: s370

A step.

evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: even my existence was taken away by you.

mm-0880.reason: SHIKI says Shiki stole even his reason or meaning for existing, not his literal existence—he has just insisted that he remains alive. The English breaks that contrast and flattens an existential grievance into a physical impossibility.
mm-0880.title: SHIKI says Shiki stole even his reason or meaning for existing, not his literal existence—he has just insisted that he remains alive

I start to breathe heavily.

mm-1110.reason: Shiki is afraid that if he himself moves rashly, the act will amount to admitting his abnormality; the English makes an external 'anything' the moving subject. It also calls the revolving red-and-black visual pattern a police siren rather than police-car lights.
mm-1110.title: Shiki is afraid that if he himself moves rashly, the act will amount to admitting his abnormality; the English makes an external 'anything' the moving subject

さすがに目の届く場所には見あたらないか」
　あるとしたら鍵のかかった所だろう。
　机の引き出しあたりを、とりあえず見てみよう。

evidence.japanese:
いや、あの感応者の子供がいればあと数年は保つだろう。
　だがあの子供のほうは私の行為に耐えきれまい。
　おそらく、あの子供が壊れた後、私は自らの手で自分の命を絶たなければなるまい。
　……皮肉なものだ。
　自身を守るために多くの障害を排除してきた私は、結局は自身の手で命を絶たなければならないらしい。
　それとも、これは七夜の呪いなのか。
　戯れでヤツの息子を飼ってみたが、その程度ではヤツの怨念は断ち切れなかったという事か。

evidence.japanese:
補足。
　七夜の血筋は、ある種殺人鬼を輩出する一族である。
　もしあの養子が生き残ってしまった場合、命を共有して繋がっているシキに悪影響を及ぼすだろう。
　折角理性を取り戻したシキが、七夜の養子に引きずられて『殺人鬼』になってしまう可能性も否定できない。
　そのような事態が起きないよう、養子は目の届く範囲で飼わなければならない。
だが遠野の屋敷に近づける事も許されない。
　管理に適切な分家筋を選んでほしい。
